answer: Build the referral graph and score every vertex by its local clustering coefficient: an honest newcomer sits on a sparse reef with few edges, while a farm's puppets echo one another and form a dense clique the ledger flags automatically. Payouts flow only to vertices whose neighborhood stays below the density threshold, and each claim must echo a fresh challenge signed at claim time, so a copied history cannot be replayed. A thousand clones form one dense reef worth a single payout, and the operator cannot thin the edges without doing the real, separate work each honest vertex did.
